title: Merge overlapping intervals
goal: Make mergeIntervals(intervals) and totalCoverage(intervals) in src/intervals.js correct and add comprehensive tests.

steps.title: Implement interval merging functions
steps.detail: src/intervals.js exports mergeIntervals(intervals) and totalCoverage(intervals). An interval is a two-element array [start, end] of numbers with start <= end. mergeIntervals returns a NEW array of merged intervals sorted by start and does not change its input: overlapping intervals merge, and intervals that only touch also merge ([1,3] and [3,5] become [1,5]); nested intervals are absorbed; the input may be unsorted; an empty array gives []. An interval with start greater than end makes mergeIntervals throw a RangeError. totalCoverage returns the sum of (end - start) of the merged intervals. Examples: [[1,3],[2,6],[8,10],[15,18]] becomes [[1,6],[8,10],[15,18]]; [[1,4],[4,5]] becomes [[1,5]]; [[5,6],[1,2]] becomes [[1,2],[5,6]]; [[1,10],[2,3]] becomes [[1,10]]; [] becomes []; [[2,1]] throws RangeError; totalCoverage([[1,3],[2,6],[8,10]]) is 7; totalCoverage([]) is 0; the input array [[3,4],[1,2]] is unchanged after the call. Export with module.exports = { mergeIntervals, totalCoverage } (CommonJS). Add tests in test/intervals.test.js (node:test) that cover every rule and example.

steps.title: Run the whole test suite
steps.detail: Run npm test. Change nothing unless it fails; fix only failures that this plan's change caused.
